source_note: Kelley supplies SbO(g) heat-content and entropy increments; the NBS Table 21 value anchors formation enthalpy at 298.15 K. The absolute entropy is inferred by closing the Kelley increments against Sohn et al.'s selected liquid-Sb reaction and NUREG Table 12's Sb(g)-Sb(l) Gibbs difference at 1200, 1400, 1600, 1800, and 2000 K. The NUREG SbO(g) Gibbs function is retained separately as a large, non-statistical disagreement envelope.
